title: Prove the resonant characteristic-five disjointness repair law
body:
The characteristic-five disjointness repair matrix is singular for a different repeated-root reason from the earlier characteristic-three source. This package proves its exact additive rank-one repair count for every resonant h divisible by four: 2^h−1−b_h, with b_h given by the five-state Jordan tensor recurrence. It proves the proper-set deletion correction and supplies the finite five-rule rank certificate over every characteristic-five field. The first literal source ranks are 9 at h=4 and 185 at h=8.

The package credits PR #4962 and #5173 and does not revisit the concurrently claimed even characteristic-three problem. It is an algebraic rank theorem, not a physical supplier or a selected multiplication-bound improvement.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized checks; independent binomial-power, similarity, kernel and column-rank controls; exact input history; official ten-file export; readonly Git-free cold checks; eight actual source/receipt/scientific mutations rejected in both modes. Independent AI-assisted proof review passed. No Lean or historical suite was run.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0 and predecessor attribution retained.
